answer:
Checkpoint 60 reached. `/work/map.json` updated.

**Corrections made this segment:**

1. **Fixed a height-estimation bug.** I had been computing object heights as `1.55 - (v_top-256)*D/396.8`, but 396.8 = f·1.55 is the *depth* constant; the focal length is 256. All my earlier height figures were inflated ~1.55×. Corrected values are physically sensible (cabinet top ≈0.73 m, sofa back ≈0.88 m).

2. **Resolved the gray object — it is one sofa.** This flip-flopped, so I chased it down: obs_0047/0053/0054 clearly show an **armrest and backrest**, ruling out the "counter" call from checkpoint 40. The compact appearance in obs_0048 was an end-on foreshortened view from its south end. The long extents I measured in obs_0023/24 were partly color-threshold bleed with the cabinet behind it. Settled as a single L-shaped sofa at (2.85, 6.75), confidence 0.75.

3. **Verified the map core by resection, not dead reckoning.** obs_0056 gave a 4-landmark fix at **4.9 px rms**, and obs_0037 gave 6.5 px — both independently reproducing the vase, chair, stool, and lamp positions. These four are now high-confidence (0.93–0.95).

**Coverage:** East strip, corridor, SE corner, and south wall all swept — **no new objects found**. Walls pinned: west x = -3.30, east x = 3.54, north y = 8.08.

**Current map:**

| id | category | x, y | conf |
|---|---|---|---|
| wooden_chair_1 | chair | -2.60, 3.70 | 0.95 |
| floor_lamp_1 | floor lamp | -2.42, 5.85 | 0.95 |
| round_stool_1 | stool | -0.90, 5.40 | 0.93 |
| blue_vase_1 | vase | -2.46, 1.45 | 0.93 |
| potted_plant_1 | potted plant | 1.22, 2.55 | 0.90 |
| cabinet_1 | cabinet | 2.55, 3.90 | 0.85 |
| dark_table_1 | table | 2.50, 1.45 | 0.90 |
| gray_sofa_1 | sofa | 2.85, 6.75 | 0.75 |

**Next segment:** The object count has been stable at 8 across three segments with no new detections in the last 20 frames, so the inventory is likely complete. I'll spend remaining frames confirming the south wall's true y (only ever seen obliquely), checking the region behind/east of the sofa, and tightening the sofa and plant centroids — then consider early stop.
